content: {"episode_id":"ep-05033","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"Medical necessity review is requested for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229). The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and a personal history of transient ischemic attacks. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic episodes and to optimize rate control management."}
